load.transformation: Rounded representative scale calibrated to sector electricity consumption divided by more than 100 manufacturers; hourly shape is an explicit deterministic model assumption.

price.transformation: Deterministic positive hourly shape rescaled separately in each month to match OMIE 2025 official monthly arithmetic day-ahead means exactly; not raw OMIE hourly settlement data.

pv.classification: PROXY calibrated to PVGIS-derived public data
pv.transformation: Deterministic solar/day-cloud shape rescaled monthly to public PVGIS-v5.3-derived Castelló yield totals; not raw PVGIS hourly series.
